result.title: GeoRead3D: Grounding Part Descriptions for 3D Pointing and Reorientation
result.summary: Language often refers to an object by its parts, as in asking to point to a part or to turn an arbitrarily posed object so that two named parts lie in given directions. Both tasks need the direction from the object's center to the part's center, not the part's own orientation. A natural approach segments the part and takes the centroid of its mask. However, high mask overlap predicts the pointing direction poorly when a part is spread out relative to its distance from the object center. Language-guided part segmentation is trained and evaluated by mask overlap, which leaves a gap between the masks it produces and the part geometry that these tasks use. We close this gap by learning point evidence, weights over the observed points whose weighted centroid gives the part's location. Geometric Readout Supervision (GRS) trains these weights through the centroid's position and adds direction supervision on the parts used in reorientation commands. GRS improves both tasks even with a single frozen encoder and a single input pose. We implement this supervision in GeoRead3D, a system for pointing and reorientation from part descriptions. A language model maps each description to a known part name. Dual-Route Part Evidence combines refined segmentation evidence with directly predicted point evidence to locate each part. On PartNeXt and Artiverse, GeoRead3D points within $22.5^\circ$ for 74.1% and 60.0% of queries, 5.8 and 7.3 percentage points above the strongest baselines. Its reorientation success exceeds the strongest baselines by 10.4 and 7.8 points.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究从部件描述进行 3D 指向与物体重定向，提出学习观测点上的证据权重、以加权质心定位部件，并用几何读出监督（GRS）透过质心位置与方向训练这些权重；系统 GeoRead3D 将分割证据与直接预测的点证据双路融合。
AI.relevance_reason: 用下游几何读出替代掩码重叠作为监督信号，可能为 latent 状态的读出式监督与贡献分配提供线索，其双路证据加权融合可供核查是否类比视觉证据筛选。
